en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European village in a valley, with densely packed gabled houses and farm buildings surrounded by trees and fields. In the middle distance a long multi‑arched viaduct or railway bridge crosses the landscape, and a tall industrial chimney stands near the settlement. Beyond are cultivated fields laid out in strips and low forested hills on the horizon. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
